# Row kinds. REPO: donor repository -> GitHub URL (PROVENANCE.tsv builds blob URLs from it). BASE: target path -> sha256 of the host file this recipe was planned against (M3JDK master 40726696321; PROVENANCE base_match). MERGE: donor .java -> existing target .java (the donor type's members join the target type between two //FLLDCIM: RELOCATE-MERGE anchors; donor imports the target lacks are inserted). APPEND: donor .c -> existing target .c (donor body appended between the anchors). FILE: donor .java -> new target .java. PACKAGE: donor package -> target package. TYPE: donor top-level type -> target type (whole word). MEMBER: donor member name -> target member name (whole word, Java). EXTERNAL: third-party package kept as it is. JNI: exported symbol prefix of the donor class -> prefix of the host class (C). DROP_LINE <DonorType>#<regex>, DROP_METHOD <DonorType>.<method>: declared removals with their reason (a dropped declaration takes the blank line after it). REWRITE <DonorType>#<regex> -> replacement: declared substitution with its reason. INSERT_BLOCK <DonorType or C stem> -> \n-separated lines appended at the end of the merged block (the host's own lazy ABI-probe pattern). SKIP: donor file not relocated, with its owner or reason. NEC: equivalence not decided (recorded, not resolved).
